name: Eastern Purple Coneflower
desc: Eastern Purple Coneflower (Echinacea purpurea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 18 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Echinacea purpurea, the eastern purple coneflower, purple coneflower, hedgehog coneflower, or Echinacea, is a North American species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae.
